newsitem.title: POLAND: Komunalny convertible bonds issue May '97.
newsitem.headline: Komunalny convertible bonds issue May '97.

text.p: Polish Bank Komunalny SA plans to issue convertible bonds in May next year, the bank said in a statement.
It said the supervisory board of the bank set the subscription period for May 20-24 next year.
It earlier said it planned to issue two million, 30-month convertible bonds to raise about 50 million zlotys.
It said the minimal issue price would be at least as high as the average price of the stock at three bourse sessions' ending four days before the subscription begins. @
Komunalny said the bonds would carry two coupons of one zloty each, paid after 12 months and 24 months from the date of closing the subscription.
It said one bond could be exchanged for the bank's 0.8 share from May 25, 1998 to November 25, 1999 and for one share from May 25, 1999 to November 25, 1999.
Earlier the bank said it wanted to list the bonds on the Warsaw Stock Exchange.
